system.notes:
A spherical, 20-foot-tall, iron- skinned behemoth standing astride four square legs. Covered with crimson eyes, mouth of grinding teeth.

AC 16, HP 50, ATK 3 bite +6 (2d8 + swallow) or soul breath, MV near (burrow), S +5, D +3, C +5, I +1, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 10

Great Evil. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Soul Breath. Once soul has been consumed, daemon can expel it as a shrieking black wind, straight line (5' wide) extending double near from daemon. CHA 15+ or 5d10 damage.

Swallow. On a bite attack roll of 19-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round, die and soul consumed at 0 HP. Daemon regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
